messages:
maria_sales: Need quick approval for a one-time amendment for ZenHealth. Asking for 25% off Dedicated seat pricing for first year + Net60 payment terms. Theyre a public hospital network; sensitive onboarding and long procurement cycle. Asking to waive onboarding SOW fee too.

ben_dealdesk: Why 25%? Any precedent in playbook? Whats TCV and expected upsell?

maria_sales: TCV (12mo) at proposed = $375k (list would be $500k). Upsell thesis: clinical imaging integrations + 24mo roadmap, projected $900k Y2. They want Net60 due to internal finance cycles; procurement won't sign Net30.

sandra_revops: Quick numbers:
```
List: $500,000
Proposed: $375,000
Discount: 25%
Estimated contribution margin: ~18%
```
If onboard support cost is >$30k we should not waive full SOW fee without trade.

harry_finance: Net60 is risky but acceptable for public hospitals if we require a signed PO and a non-refundable initial milestone payment (10% upfront). Otherwise push for Net45.

maria_sales: Theyre firm on Net60. Can we accept 10% upfront + PO + milestone invoice at provisioning? They will do PO but cannot pay early due to budget calendars.

ben_dealdesk: For onboarding SOW waiver: propose to convert onboarding fee into a time-limited service credit (e.g., $25k credited against first 3 invoices) instead of absolute waiver. Also add a performance milestone: if they do not commit to imaging integration by month 9, a partial rebate triggers.

olga_legal: We need contract language for public sector data controls and a termination-for-convenience (with 60-day notice) carve-out. Also include explicit no retro credits and a clawback tied to expansion milestone. I can draft amendment today.

maria_sales: Theyve asked for strict confidentiality and a public reference ok after go-live. Sales wants stronger trade for waiver: 2 case study sessions + intro to health system group.

harry_finance: Finance provisional ok for 25% off + credit-for-onboarding approach provided: (1) 10% non-refundable upfront payment or signed PO with budget authority letter, (2) SOW credit instead of fee waiver, (3) Net60 documented and final approval routed through AR, (4) clawback milestone at month 12 for expansion. Need legal draft and PO before provisioning. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Created billing draft: /invoices/templates/zenhealth_amendment_draft_v1.docx

ben_dealdesk: Tagging @olga_legal for amendment draft. Also note: do not open public pricing spreadsheet until billing confirms final SKU mapping.

olga_legal: Drafting amendment now. Will include payment milestone language and public sector clause. Send me the exact SOW items to convert into credits.

maria_sales: Sending SOW list to @olga_legal and posting PO thread when it arrives. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

harry_finance: Once PO and signed amendment are in place I will finalize approval and instruct billing to apply credits. Keep thread updated.

ben_dealdesk: Marking provisional approved pending docs/PO. Will escalate if procurement pushes for full fee waiver. :thumbsup:
